nodes.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot
nodes.summary: AI assistance integrated into Microsoft 365 work contexts.

explanations.explorer: AI assistance integrated into Microsoft 365 work contexts.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Try a supported summarization task with synthetic content and compare the output with its source.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Identify the licensed experience, data boundary and administrator controls before a pilot.

nodes.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio
nodes.summary: A platform for designing and managing conversational AI agents.

explanations.explorer: A platform for designing and managing conversational AI agents.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Define one agent purpose, then configure only the knowledge and tools that purpose needs.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review channels, identities, data policies and release ownership before publishing.

nodes.title: Power Automate
nodes.summary: A platform for automating workflows across applications and services.

explanations.explorer: A platform for automating workflows across applications and services.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Build a small trigger-and-action flow with synthetic inputs and inspect a failed run.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Define connection ownership, failure handling and the environments used for release.

nodes.title: Power Apps
nodes.summary: Tools for building low-code business applications.

explanations.explorer: Tools for building low-code business applications.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Sketch a short user task, then build a readable screen with clear validation feedback.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Choose the app type and data source alongside sharing and lifecycle requirements.

nodes.title: Microsoft Dataverse
nodes.summary: A data platform commonly used by Power Platform applications.

explanations.explorer: A data platform commonly used by Power Platform applications.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Model a small synthetic dataset with tables and relationships.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review role boundaries and effective data access before sharing the app.

nodes.title: SharePoint
nodes.summary: A Microsoft 365 platform for collaboration and information management.

explanations.explorer: A Microsoft 365 platform for collaboration and information management.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Select a small, maintained set of pages or documents for a knowledge experiment.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Define content ownership and verify source-specific access behavior before connecting it.

nodes.title: Microsoft Graph
nodes.summary: A developer API for accessing supported Microsoft 365 data and capabilities.

explanations.explorer: A developer API for accessing supported Microsoft 365 data and capabilities.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Read one endpoint contract and inspect its permissions before trying a synthetic request.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Distinguish application access from delegated access and review the scope of consent.

nodes.title: Microsoft Entra ID
nodes.summary: An identity and access management service for Microsoft cloud environments.

explanations.explorer: An identity and access management service for Microsoft cloud environments.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Identify the user or application identity involved in a sample access decision.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review identity lifecycle, least privilege and the policies protecting the resource.

nodes.title: Azure Functions
nodes.summary: A cloud platform for running event-driven code without managing servers directly.

explanations.explorer: A cloud platform for running event-driven code without managing servers directly.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: For an HTTP function, define a request, response and useful failure result.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Choose authentication and operational ownership; do not treat a callable URL as authorization.

nodes.title: Foundry Tools
nodes.summary: Prebuilt AI capabilities with dedicated SDKs, formerly called Azure AI Services.

explanations.explorer: Prebuilt AI capabilities with dedicated SDKs, formerly called Azure AI Services.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Compare a prebuilt tool with the task you need to solve before choosing an SDK.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review the selected tool endpoint and lifecycle; this node does not represent the whole Foundry platform.

nodes.title: Power Platform admin center
nodes.summary: Administrative experiences for managing and governing Power Platform environments.

explanations.explorer: Administrative experiences for managing and governing Power Platform environments.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Locate the environment, users and policies relevant to a synthetic solution.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Define ownership and review boundaries across environments before broad sharing.

nodes.title: Microsoft Teams
nodes.summary: Microsoft collaboration, meetings and communication platform.

explanations.explorer: Microsoft collaboration, meetings and communication platform.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Compare a supported Copilot task in Teams with the original conversation content.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Check the available experience and applicable tenant settings before a pilot.

nodes.title: AI fundamentals
nodes.summary: Core ideas behind AI systems, strengths, limits and safe use.

explanations.explorer: Core ideas behind AI systems, strengths, limits and safe use.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Explain a model input, an output and a possible failure using a small synthetic example.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Decide what evidence would justify using an AI approach for the task.

nodes.title: Generative AI
nodes.summary: AI systems that can generate text and other content from patterns and prompts.

explanations.explorer: AI systems that can generate text and other content from patterns and prompts.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Compare responses to a few variations of one request and record unsupported output.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Plan how uncertainty, evaluation and human review affect the solution.

nodes.title: Prompt design
nodes.summary: Designing clear instructions and context for AI-assisted workflows.

explanations.explorer: Designing clear instructions and context for AI-assisted workflows.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Write a clear task and constraints, then test examples inside and outside the intended scope.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Treat instructions as behavior guidance; enforce permissions through actual access controls.

nodes.title: AI agents
nodes.summary: AI experiences that can respond using tools, context, and configured workflows.

explanations.explorer: AI experiences that can respond using tools, context, and configured workflows.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Define a narrow goal and identify which configured resources the agent needs.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Assign responsibility for permissions, failure handling and release review.

nodes.title: Knowledge sources
nodes.summary: Approved data and documents used to inform agent responses.

explanations.explorer: Approved data and documents used to inform agent responses.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Choose a small source set and test questions with and without an answer in that material.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review source ownership, freshness and the authentication behavior of each source type.

nodes.title: Retrieval and grounding
nodes.summary: Patterns for anchoring AI answers in relevant retrieved content.

explanations.explorer: Patterns for anchoring AI answers in relevant retrieved content.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Compare a response with the material retrieved for it and record missing context.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Plan for irrelevant results and unavailable sources; grounding is not a correctness guarantee.

nodes.title: Agent actions and tools
nodes.summary: Capabilities allowing an agent to invoke defined operations.

explanations.explorer: Capabilities allowing an agent to invoke defined operations.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Describe one operation with inputs, outputs and a safe failure result before connecting it.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review who authorizes the operation and what happens if a write is repeated.

nodes.title: Connectors
nodes.summary: Integration mechanisms between services and workflow tools.

explanations.explorer: Integration mechanisms between services and workflow tools.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Inspect an action contract and connection requirements with synthetic data.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review permissions and data policies for each connection used by the solution.

nodes.title: Cloud flows
nodes.summary: Automated or triggered workflow sequences in Power Automate.

explanations.explorer: Automated or triggered workflow sequences in Power Automate.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Build a trigger and action, then check what happens when required input is missing.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Plan connection ownership, retries and operational support for the flow.

nodes.title: Business process mapping
nodes.summary: Turning real-world workflows into explicit steps, actors and decisions.

explanations.explorer: Turning real-world workflows into explicit steps, actors and decisions.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Write the trigger, actors, expected result and exceptions before choosing an automation.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Identify process ownership and approval boundaries before changing how work is done.

nodes.title: App user experience
nodes.summary: Designing usable forms, states and task-oriented screens.

explanations.explorer: Designing usable forms, states and task-oriented screens.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Design one task with labelled controls and helpful validation, then try it by keyboard.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review accessibility and user feedback together with data and sharing boundaries.

nodes.title: Data modeling
nodes.summary: Structuring records, relationships and validation rules.

explanations.explorer: Structuring records, relationships and validation rules.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Choose entities, fields and relationships for a fictional workflow.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review ownership, sensitive fields and how changes affect dependent components.

nodes.title: Access control
nodes.summary: Deciding and enforcing which identities can access which resources.

explanations.explorer: Deciding and enforcing which identities can access which resources.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Describe who may read or change a resource and test an allowed and denied case.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Separate identity from authorization and review the effective privileges of each actor.

nodes.title: Governance
nodes.summary: Policies, ownership and controls for responsible technology usage.

explanations.explorer: Policies, ownership and controls for responsible technology usage.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Identify an owner and applicable environment policies for a sample solution.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Make release review, support and access decisions explicit rather than relying on maker intent.

nodes.title: Application lifecycle management
nodes.summary: Processes for versioning, testing, releasing and maintaining solutions.

explanations.explorer: Processes for versioning, testing, releasing and maintaining solutions.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Describe how a small change moves from development to a reviewed release.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Define ownership, rollback and the source of truth for releases.

nodes.title: Monitoring and evaluation
nodes.summary: Observability and tests that help detect failures and assess quality.

explanations.explorer: Observability and tests that help detect failures and assess quality.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Record expected and observed results for normal, missing-answer and failure cases.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Separate design-time checks from published-channel and operational acceptance.

nodes.title: API fundamentals
nodes.summary: Understanding requests, responses, authentication and error handling.

explanations.explorer: Understanding requests, responses, authentication and error handling.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Describe a request, response, status and error for a small HTTP operation.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Review authentication, permissions and compatibility when changing the interface.

nodes.title: Solution deployment
nodes.summary: Moving tested software and configuration safely across environments.

explanations.explorer: Moving tested software and configuration safely across environments.
explanations.builder: MSkill practice: Identify the components and target environment for a small solution release.
explanations.architect: MSkill design review: Plan review, rollback and environment responsibilities before importing changes.

edges.rationale: MSkill suggested learning order: study AI fundamentals before Generative AI. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Generative AI before Prompt design. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Generative AI before AI agents. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill editorial connection: data modeling helps organize structured knowledge. It is not a universal prerequisite for adding a document as an agent knowledge source.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Knowledge sources before Retrieval and grounding. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study API fundamentals before Agent actions and tools. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Business process mapping before Cloud flows. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Business process mapping before App user experience. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill editorial connection: Microsoft Entra ID is an identity platform relevant to access control. The general access-control concept does not require this specific product.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Governance before Monitoring and evaluation. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Application lifecycle management before Solution deployment. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
MSkill suggested learning order: study Prompt design before AI agents. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
Cloud flows are a Power Automate workflow category; this hierarchy does not make every automation a cloud flow.
MSkill editorial connection: app user experience is a design concern when building Power Apps; the general skill is not a component owned by Power Apps.
Configured tools can extend an agent with service operations. Tools are optional; an agent does not inherently have every available action.
MSkill editorial connection: an agent may consult knowledge sources. Those sources can exist independently of the agent and are not necessarily part of it.
MSkill connects Microsoft 365 Copilot with generative AI to explain generated assistance in work contexts; availability depends on the licensed experience.
Copilot Studio provides an environment for authoring agents. Publishing and available features depend on the selected experience and tenant requirements.
Power Automate supports building cloud flows around triggers and actions; the specific services used determine connection requirements.
Canvas apps provide controls and layouts for application interfaces. MSkill treats interface design as a broader skill than using this product.
Dataverse supports tables and relationships for business data models. Choosing an appropriate model remains a design task.
Connectors expose service operations for automation. Individual operations still require their configured connections and permissions.
Knowledge sources supply material for retrieval-based grounding; their presence alone does not guarantee relevant or correct answers.
Entra ID supports identity and access management. MSkill distinguishes that implementation from the broader access-control discipline.
MSkill recommends describing a process trigger, desired result and exceptions before automating it. This is planning advice, not a product prerequisite.
Understanding API inputs, outputs and errors helps when designing custom tools. Using a prebuilt tool need not require writing an API.
Generative AI can support agents that interpret requests and produce responses. This relationship does not imply every agent uses a generative model.
Copilot Studio and Power Automate have connected flow authoring scenarios. Check the documented flow type, environment and billing requirements before reuse.
Copilot Studio supports SharePoint knowledge sources. Access depends on the source configuration and authentication; connecting a site is not blanket permission.
Copilot Studio can use Dataverse tables as knowledge with the documented search, authentication and permission setup.
A canvas app control can trigger a Power Automate flow. App and flow connections must be configured for the intended users.
Power Apps can build on Dataverse tables. This is a supported data option, not a requirement for every canvas app.
A Power Automate flow can use a Teams connector action, such as posting a message, through an authorized connection.
The SharePoint connector provides list and library triggers and actions for Power Automate flows.
The Dataverse connector exposes data operations and triggers to Power Automate; the chosen connection must have the required access.
Custom server-side logic, including Azure Functions, can be exposed to Power Automate through an API connector. This requires deliberate API and authentication configuration.
Microsoft Graph exposes supported Teams APIs. An application must request the permissions required by each operation.
Microsoft Graph exposes supported SharePoint APIs. The available operation and granted permissions determine which content an application can access.
MSkill links the Microsoft 365 assistance experience with Copilot Studio agent authoring. These are distinct products; licensing and deployment choices must be checked separately.
Copilot Studio agents can be configured with knowledge sources. Source selection is optional and should match the intended questions.
Copilot Studio agents can call configured tools. Tool availability and authorization must be established before an agent can use them.
Copilot Studio can use Power Platform connectors to expose service operations as tools; a connector is not an automatic grant of access.
Cloud flows can use connector triggers and actions. A flow does not automatically use every connector or service.
Dataverse is used by model-driven apps and can supply data to canvas apps. Canvas apps can also use other data sources.
Knowledge-grounded agents can retrieve source material to inform responses. Retrieval is one design pattern, not a requirement for every agent.
HTTP-triggered Azure Functions receive requests and return responses. API design knowledge is relevant to that pattern; other trigger types exist.
Power Platform data policies can restrict Copilot Studio capabilities and connections. Effective controls depend on the applicable tenant and environment policies.
MSkill recommends reviewing Power Automate environment access and data policies before sharing automations.
MSkill recommends reviewing Power Apps sharing, environment access and data policies before making an app available to others.
MSkill treats authentication and allowed tool access as agent design decisions. Instructions alone are not an authorization boundary.
Access behavior differs between knowledge-source types. Review each source configuration; do not assume uploaded content inherits per-user source permissions.
Dataverse provides security controls for data access. Review the effective roles and permissions for the intended users.
Power Platform administration provides controls for environments, users and policies; governance also requires organizational decisions and ownership.
Solution deployment involves target environments and administrative permissions. MSkill links this practice to Power Platform administration.
MSkill connects lifecycle management with environment administration when planning release ownership and operational support.
Power Platform solutions package components for movement between environments as part of a managed lifecycle.
MSkill recommends testing agent conversations and inspecting behavior before release. Design-time testing does not prove production-channel behavior.
MSkill suggested learning order: study API fundamentals before Microsoft Graph. This is editorial sequencing, not a universal technical requirement or a Microsoft prerequisite.
HTTP-triggered functions are a practical setting for learning request and response contracts; this is an editorial learning connection.
MSkill connects prebuilt Foundry Tools with agent solution design as an optional capability choice, not a required agent platform.
Foundry Tools and generative-model APIs are distinct capability families. MSkill links them for comparison when choosing an AI solution approach.
MSkill uses Dataverse tables and relationships as one concrete setting for practicing data modeling.
SharePoint is a supported source option for Copilot Studio knowledge. Relevance and access must be reviewed for the selected site content.
Teams offers Copilot experiences in collaboration workflows; exact availability depends on licensing and administrator configuration.
MSkill recommends reviewed deployment, ownership and rollback decisions as part of release governance.
Application lifecycle management includes governance across development, deployment and maintenance; it is broader than packaging a release.
Copilot Studio provides conversation testing and activity inspection. MSkill recommends recording expected and observed outcomes separately.
MSkill links Power Apps to interface design practice: clear controls, readable layouts and useful feedback still require deliberate design.
A business process supplies context for choosing what a flow should automate. The relationship is editorial planning guidance.
MSkill treats access decisions as one part of governance, alongside ownership and operational policy.
Agent flows can perform multi-step operations for an agent. Check the supported flow pattern before treating an existing cloud flow as an agent tool.
